name: Cream-Fried Eggs
desc: Eggs fried in heavy cream that cooks down to browned butter, for crisp buttery edges.

source.title: Cream-Fried Eggs
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Pour the cream into an 8-inch nonstick skillet that has a lid and set it over medium heat.
Let the cream simmer, stirring now and then, about 2 to 3 minutes until the water cooks off, the bubbles get small and the cream separates into butterfat and golden milk solids.
Turn the heat to medium-low, crack in the eggs and season with salt and pepper. Cook 1 to 2 minutes until the whites are set on the bottom and the edges are brown and crisp.
Cover and cook 1 to 2 minutes more, until the tops of the whites are set and the yolks are done the way you like them.
tips: Use heavy cream; lighter creams have too little fat to fry in.
Add a splash more cream if the pan goes dry before the eggs are done.
